articles.summary: Diffusion Studio for Windows is available. Connect Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or Gemini CLI and edit video on your PC.
articles.title: Diffusion Studio for Windows

articles.summary: Create custom controls for data-driven video projects and recurring production workflows. Define the content, design, and editing rules, then switch between versions with a single selection or ask your agent to produce variants in bulk. Reuse the same project for localized videos, product catalogs, recurring reports, social media content, or any other type of video production.
articles.title: Custom controls for video projects
